hero.title: How teams use an AI agent before the first booked call.
hero.body: Prospects want answers before they book. Steps AI handles those questions, so by the time someone books, they already know whether you are the right fit.

stories.excerpt: We get a lot of questions from people who are interested but not ready to talk to sales yet. StepsAI handles that part really well. By the time someone books with us, they’ve usually already checked pricing, integrations, and whether we can support their use case.

capabilities.title: What the AI booking agent does.

items.title: Book into your calendar
items.body: Connect Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Calendly, Cal.com or Square Appointments.

items.title: Answer questions before booking
items.body: Pricing, integrations and fit questions get answered in the chat first.

items.title: Collect the details you need
items.body: Name, email, company and job title are collected before the booking is made.
